title: Se presenta en la Ciudad de México por primera vez el grupo de rock estadounidense The Doors en el Fórum.
text: The Doors fue una banda de rock y blues estadounidense, formada en Los Ángeles, California en julio de 1965 y disuelta en 1973.​ Según la Recording Industry Association Of America (RIAA), The Doors ha vendido 33.000.000 de unidades de álbumes certificadas en los Estados Unidos. La banda ha vendido más de 100.000.000 de álbumes en todo el mundo.

title: Allende meteorite falls in Allende, Chihuahua.
text: The Allende meteorite is the largest carbonaceous chondrite ever found on Earth. The fireball was witnessed at 01:05 on February 8, 1969, falling over the Mexican state of Chihuahua.

title: The Universidad Regiomontana, the Autonomous University of Nayarit and the University of Monterrey are established.
text: The University of Monterrey is a private, Catholic, secondary, and higher education institution in city-municipality San Pedro Garza García, Greater Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico.

title: Mina de Barroterán coal mine disaster
text: Mina de Barroterán coal mine disaster occurred on March 31, 1969, and 153 miners were killed. This was the second worst disaster in Mexico's coal mining history, second only to the Mina Rosita Vieja disaster of 1908.

title: Mexicana Flight 704
text: On 4 June 1969, Mexicana de Aviación Flight 704, a Boeing 727 airliner registered XA-SEL, crashed near El Carmen, some 20 miles north of the city of Monterrey, Nuevo León. All 79 people on board were killed.

title: June 21: 1970 FIFA World Cup
text: The 1970 FIFA World Cup was the ninth edition of the FIFA World Cup, the quadrennial international football championship for men's senior national teams. Held from 31 May to 21 June in Mexico, it was the first World Cup tournament held outside Europe and South America, and also the first hosted in North America.

title: 5: 1969 World Judo Championships held in Mexico City.
text: The 1969 World Judo Championships were the sixth edition of the men's World Judo Championships, and were held in Mexico City, Mexico from 23–25 October, 1969.
